text:
sam: quick heads up - after the KMS keystore rotation yesterday the audit shipper in eu-west started a high-QPS reindex; privatelink NATs are seeing conntrack pressure and several GPU warm-pool nodes failed to finish onboarding.

infra-bot: [ALERT] privatelink-euw conntrack_slab_high; keystore-exporter 502/503 surge; warmpool-join-failures=18.

rachel: Paste from node-12: 
```
Mar 23 01:02:14 kubelet: warmup pod failed: keystore exporter timeout
kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
keystore-exporter euw org=keystore svc=exporter status=504 latency=1203ms
```

omar: This is the exporter burst during reindex + retention policy change. Short fixes: 1) temporarily lower keystore index retention for exporter-facing index, 2) bump nf_conntrack_max on NATs, 3) throttle exporter QPS with a dynamic token-bucket.

finance-bot: note: changing retention from 180d -> 60d for keystore export reduces monthly euw egress/storage cost ~-$6.2k (approx).

sam: Prefer scoped rollback for exporter index only (not full retention) while infra adds rate-limit. Rachel, can you run conntrack bump and collect pre/post metrics? Omar, can you prepare a canary throttle policy?

rachel: Running: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=240000` on edge NATs now. Monitoring conntrack_count and warm-pool join rate.

omar: Canary throttle config (rate-limit per-org): 
```
exporter.rate_limit: 200rps
burst: 400
target_services: keystore-exporter
```

infra-bot: [INFO] conntrack_max updated on NAT fleet. conntrack_count=175420 -> 178900 (rising).

sam: If Security will approve a scoped retention rollback for exporter index, we can avoid diverting capacity. I'll open a compliance exception and ping @security. Document cost delta in ticket.

rachel: 10m update: conntrack growth slowed after bump; exporter 503s dropped ~55%; warm-pool join success 36% -> 82%. Will keep watching.

omar: Pushing throttle canary to 10% of exporter replicas now. If no errors in 15m, we scale to 100%.

finance-bot: add long-term note: if Security requires 180d we should schedule exporter batching + async SQS staging to smooth spikes; estimated infra implementation ~2w dev + 1w rollout cost ~$4k/mo lower ops margin.

sam: Plan: (1) scoped rollback for exporter index -> 60d (canary), (2) conntrack bump applied, (3) throttle canary now, (4) monitor 30m then decide route (revert rollback or keep and build batching). If euw instability persists we'll route new GPU allocations to eu-north temporarily.

infra-bot: [RESOLVE] alert suppressed after remediation window. follow-up tickets: #PLAT-8922 exporter-batching, #COMPL-3113 retention-canary.

sam: thanks. keep updates to this thread only. if we need pager duty escalate.
